answer: The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in saffron, expire in reef, and plume lists each expiry. An attacker running 94 aliases therefore needs 56 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3743 identities would post 4690 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
